shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/; git status --short | head -20

cat AGENTS.md; echo ---; find src -type f | xargs ls -la; echo ---; cat src/* 2>/dev/null | head -150; echo ---; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version)"
grep -n -i -A12 "dashkit" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; echo ---; npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | head -40

node -e "console.log('icons', require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').version)" ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head; npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit@10.5.2 2>&1 | tail -15; node -e "console.log('dashkit', require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json').version)"; node -e "console.log('icons', require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').version)"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/

cat package.json | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -5; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh dashkit DashKit Widget ConfigItem 2>&1 | head -80
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; echo ---; ls -R node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && ls; cat index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ---; find . -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -ln "DashKitProps\|PluginRenderer\|DashKitPlugin\|interface Plugin" | head;

cat typings/plugin.d.ts; echo ---; cat components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts; echo ---; cat components/DashKit/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---; ls components/DashKit; echo ---; cat shared/types/index.d.ts | head -80

cat shared/types/config.d.ts; echo ---; cat shared/types/state-and-params.d.ts | head -60; echo ---; cat typings/common.d.ts | head -80; echo ---; cat plugins/index.d.ts; echo ---; cat components/index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies dependencies 2>/dev/null; echo ---; grep -rn "Ru\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -rln "enum Lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -3; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/Text/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/constants.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 version peerDependencies 2>/dev/null | tail -20; echo; npm view @gravity-ui/charts time --json 2>/dev/null | tail -3 >/dev/null; npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit@10.5.2 peerDependencies 2>/dev/null

npm install @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 @gravity-ui/icons@^2.23.1 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -4; node -e "for (const p of ['dashkit','charts','icons','uikit']) console.log(p, require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json').version)"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/ 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs/* 2>/dev/null | head -30

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build 2>/dev/null | head; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts -name "INDEX.md" -o -name "README.md" -maxdepth 3 | head; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json | grep -n '"main"\|"types"\|"module"'
sed -n 1,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md
wc -l .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150
sed -n 150,373p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | grep -v "^$" | head -200

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Card/Card.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; grep -n "variant\|export" Text/Text.d.ts | head -20; echo ---; grep -n "view\|size" Button/Button.d.ts | head -20; echo ---; grep -n "theme\|type" Label/Label.d.ts | head -12; cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && ls | grep -E "^(ChartLine|ArrowRotateLeft|Square|Pencil|Persons|ShoppingCart|Bars|Bell|ArrowUpRightFromSquare|Clock|Layout|LayoutCells|Eye|ArrowDownToLine|Circle|ArrowShapeTurnUpLeft|Xmark|ArrowsRotate|Cart|Dollar|Person|ChartColumn|Heart|Ruble)" | grep -v "\.d\.ts\|\.js" | head -60

ls | sed -n 's/\.js$//p' | grep -E "^(ChartLine|ArrowRotateLeft|Pencil|Persons|ShoppingCart|Bell|Clock|LayoutCells|Eye|Dollar|Person|ChartColumn|Rocket|Hand|ArrowsRotateLeft|Lock|ListUl|Pie|ChartPie|Star|CircleInfo|TriangleExclamation|Gear|Check|Xmark|Sliders|Layers|ArrowRotateRight|Cart|Bars|ArrowsUpDown|Grip|Xmark)$" | sort | head -60; ls | sed -n 's/\.js$//p' | grep -i "^rotate\|^arrow.*rotat\|^Grip\|Move\|Arrows" | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts | head -30; echo ---; grep -n "\"\./\|css\|style" dashkit/package.json | head -20; echo ---; find dashkit/build/esm -name "*.css" | head; echo ---; ls dashkit/build/esm/i18n; sed -n 1,30p dashkit/build/esm/i18n/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---; ls dashkit/build/esm/plugins; cat dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && grep -rn "subscribeConfigure\|getConfig" --include=*.js . | head -5; grep -rn "cols:\|rowHeight\|margin:" --include=*.js components constants 2>/dev/null | head -10; cat ../../../../../tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/tsconfig.json; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/vite.config.ts; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/index.html
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/i18n/index.js | head -20; grep -rn "setLang\|lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.js | head -8

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && grep -rln "rowHeight" --include=*.js . | grep -v __tests__ | head; grep -rn "rowHeight\|cols" --include=*.js components/DashKit/DashKit.js components/GridLayout/GridLayout.js shared/constants* constants 2>/dev/null | grep -v __tests__ | head -12
grep -n "rowHeight\|margin\|cols\|isMobile" components/GridLayout/ReactGridLayout.js | head -20; grep -n "gridLayout" -r --include=*.js utils | head; cd /home/sandbox/workspace
sed -n 1,30p node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/utils/register-manager.js

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -rn "onUpdate" components/types.d.ts | head -3; grep -rn "export type ControlProps\|interface ControlProps" -A8 components/types.d.ts | head -14; grep -rn "direction" components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -3; grep -rln "ColorTextBaseProps" components/Text/*.d.ts | head -2; grep -rn "color?:" -A2 components/Text/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -6; grep -rn "export type TextColor\|TextColor =" -r . --include=*.d.ts | head -3; grep -rn "Lang" index.d.ts | head -2

grep -rn "ColorTextBaseProps\b" --include=*.d.ts . | grep "interface\|type " | head -3; grep -rn "TextColor\|color?: " components/Text/*.d.ts components/Text/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -6; grep -rn "'secondary'" components/Text/*.d.ts components/Text/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; cd /home/sandbox/workspace

grep -rn "TEXT_COLORS" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/*.js | head -3; grep -rn "TEXT_COLORS = " -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/ -r | head -8

sed -n 30,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/utils/register-manager.js; grep -n "reloadPlugins" -A6 node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.js | head -12; grep -rn "type: 'category'\|'category'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-types.md | head -3
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -60; echo "exit=$?"
npx tsc --noEmit >/tmp/tsc.log 2>&1; echo "tsc exit=$?"; grep -v "npm warn" /tmp/tsc.log | head; npx vite build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -25
cat .gitignore; echo ---; node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.dependencies)"; echo ---; git status --short
rm -rf dist && npx tsc --noEmit >/tmp/tsc2.log 2>&1; echo "tsc exit=$?"; git status --short
